errors.location: TRIANGLE-DETECTION-1 time analysis, Phase I; the later O(m^{4/3}) bound
errors.description: The stated running times omit the cost of the adjacency-matrix representation used for the constant-time edge tests. For a sparse connected graph with m = Θ(n), constructing that matrix costs Θ(n²), exceeding the claimed O(m^{4/3}) time. The manuscript does not specify an alternative constant-time edge-query structure or account for its construction.
errors.evidence: The text says Phase I runs in O(nx²) because ‘an edge test takes O(1) time using the adjacency matrix of G’; it later derives an O(m^{4/3}) bound for graphs with an arbitrary number of vertices.
